subject: Decision: robustness gate design locked
body:
Team,

Decisions, timed with today's OKR lock so the Q3 commitment is precise:

1. Fixed-seed benchmarking is approved. Amara's patch ships in our fork with the divergence documented; comparability beats fidelity to the released default here.
2. The gate is defined on two cells: background-video at medium difficulty and camera-pose at low difficulty. Hyun's argument carried the day -- camera-medium is currently so destructive (55-70% return loss in the pilot) that gating on it would just block everything; we ratchet difficulty up over time instead.
3. The Q3 OKR reads: every promoted agent reports distracting-control scores, and new agents must retain 60% of clean return on the two gate cells.

Sweep results and the full proposal go to portfolio leads July 8 as planned.

Ulla
